verdict.rationale: Synonyms are documented first-party (docs-5, docs-38), and ranking rules can be reordered (docs-23). Curation appears only as a one-line pricing-page claim of "Dynamic Search Rules" to boost, pin, or bury results per request context (docs-15, docs-30), with no technical docs on how rules are tied to specific queries. missing for 10: technical documentation of pin/boost/hide rules per query, explicit hide (not just bury) support, clarity on plan availability, independent or hands-on corroboration of curation.
